construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory using synthetic fixtures.
construction.runtime: Python 3.13.15; standard library only; implementation requires Python 3.9+

shared_schema.input: Object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, preferences, products, onboarding_steps, feedback. Unknown fields rejected.
shared_schema.preferences: interests: tag-to-weight map; excluded_ids/tags: unique string lists; priorities: price/weight-to-weight map; experience: beginner/intermediate/expert; optional limit integer 1..100, default 3. Weights finite 0..100.
shared_schema.products: Unique id, name, tags, attributes with optional price {value,unit:USD|cents} and weight {value,unit:g|kg}. Values finite, nonnegative, nonboolean.
shared_schema.onboarding_steps: Unique id, title, instructions, tags, experience_levels, prerequisites. Prerequisites reference existing ids in an acyclic graph.
shared_schema.feedback: Unique id, known product_id, nonblank text, optional known step_id or null.
shared_schema.output: One JSON object: schema_version, synthetic, status=ok, interests, compare, adaptive, feedback. Errors: status=error and error text, exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: validate(kind,value,context) is the shared boundary. Every stage validates its incoming handoff and outgoing schema, including candidate identity, normalized values, selected product, prerequisites and evidence provenance.

cross_stage_handoffs: interests -> compare: only recommended nonexcluded candidate ids and their grounded interest scores
compare -> adaptive: selected highest-ranking product and original preference/experience context
adaptive -> feedback: selected product and prerequisite-complete ordered step ids define feedback scope

behavior.interests: Sum positively weighted matching product tags; explicit id/tag exclusions override interest; sort descending score then id; apply limit; neutral candidates have explicit fallback explanations.
behavior.compare: Normalize cents to USD and kg to g. Output shared columns and per-product attribute rows. Each lower-is-better priority contributes weight*(max-value)/(max-min); equal known values contribute full priority; missing values contribute zero and remain null. Add carried interest score; descending score then id selects winner.
behavior.adaptive: Select steps matching experience and selected product tags, or untagged steps. Recursively include all prerequisites even if filtered initially. Topological ordering prioritizes currently-ready steps by user interest weights then id. Preserve fixture instructions and explain selection.
behavior.feedback: Filter to selected product and planned steps, retaining product-wide feedback. Deduplicate casefolded whitespace-normalized text within step context. Rule-based whole-word themes usability/quality/value, multi-label allowed; unmatched text goes to other. Every theme has verbatim excerpts, source ids and step ids. Duplicate counts count messages, not repeated thematic evidence.
behavior.empty: No candidates yields null selection, empty onboarding and themes; all feedback is explicitly ignored.
behavior.determinism: Stable id tie breaking; no randomness, time dependence, mutable input state, network calls or live model calls.

included: Strict shared input and handoff validation

test_outcomes.cli_result: One valid JSON object with status=ok; camera-a selected consistently across comparison, onboarding and feedback.
